findings: The player entry states the trigger, I–IV +6/9/12/15% values, tag-based living Ogryn/Monster stick condition, no stack or blessing TTL, and the actual Rumbler Bash distinction. Its two formula examples define B, q, and p, hold downstream factors fixed, and distinguish the additive damage-stat change from the final-health-damage percentage.

The final fuse clarification is accurate and source-backed: a successful stick resets projectile life-time; the .5-second minimum-life branch starts the fuse only if it has not already started, and an already-true _fuse_started flag survives the life-time reset. The strict fuse-time plus owner-lag-compensation check, first-impact suppression, and non-exploding impact reset are documented as native projectile lifecycle, not blessing duration.

Projectile damage-stat values are described as a shallow-copied creation-time snapshot, while stick eligibility checks the still-live owner's current keyword at impact. The text accurately distinguishes switching away while the weapon remains equipped from unequipping and removing the trait keyword.

RAW English and Traditional Chinese strings and hashes remain verbatim; the formatter reconstruction separately derives the selected tier's damage stat and +6/9/12/15% display. The file-name translation to 黏著炸藥 is identified as glossary-consistent document terminology, not a RAW correction.

The map, compatibility page, reverse Rumbler page, and UI review agree on exactly one binding: weapon ogryn_thumper_p2 / mark ogryn_thumper_p1_m2, actual trait weapon_trait_bespoke_ogryn_thumper_p2_grenades_stick_to_monsters, displayed as 震盪槍 洛倫茲 Mk VI. Icon path/identifier and attachment URL are distinct and consistent.

resolved_findings.detail: The final fixed scope qualifies the .5-second fuse-start condition: it applies only while the fuse has not started; _fuse_started is preserved across the sticky life-time reset. Formal source index, focused fuse proof, approved config, resume note, and extension draft are aligned on this distinction.
